ledger.name: event_name
ledger.reason: Public event label, intentionally disclosed to attendees and indexers. Do not put attendee identity or other personal data here.

ledger.name: check_in_count
ledger.reason: Public aggregate count used to demonstrate state updates without publishing attendee names. The demo does not prevent the same invite code being reused.

ledger.name: event_open
ledger.reason: Public event status so the circuit can reject check-ins after the organizer closes the event.

ledger.name: invite_commitment
ledger.reason: Public hash commitment checked against a private witness. Use a high-entropy random code; this demo is illustrative and does not provide one-time ticket security.
